senses.gloss: नह् vt. 4U (pp. नद्ध; pres. नह्यति-ते, प्रणह्यति-ते; desid. निनत्सति-ते) 1. To tie, to bind, to gird round, to bind together, e.g. बाला नह्यति किं निजालकभरं किंवा मदीयं मनः Mukundānanda; 2. (Atm.) to put on (oneself), to dress, to arm oneself.With अप-, to untie.With अपि-, (sometimes changed into पि-) 1. to fasten; 2. to cover, कुसुममिव पिनद्धं पांडुपत्रोदरेण Sak.i.; 3. to wear, to put on, कवचं पिनह्य Bt.iii.47.With उद्-, to tie up, to bind up, R.xvii.23.With परि-, to entwine, to surround, R.vi.64.With सम्-, 1. to tie, to bind, to fasten; 2. to put on, to dress; 3. to put on an armour, to arm, e.g. संनद्धः कवची खड्गी; 4. (Atm. and intransitive) to prepare oneself, to make oneself ready, छेत्तुं वज्रमणीञ्शिरीषकुसुमप्रांतेन संनह्यते Bhartr.ii.6, Megh.i.8.
नहि ind. Surely not, certainly not, by no means, नहि स्वात्मारामं विषयमृगतृष्णा भ्रमयति Mahimastotra.
नाह m. 1. Binding, confinement; 2. a trap or snare.
नाहुष m. An epithet of Yayāti.
